symptom: On a pluggable widget declaring its own `caption`/`label`/`buttonStyle`/`icon` key (PlatformDesignSystem pdsbutton, pdsformlabel): alter `set caption` -> 'widget has no Caption property'; `set buttonStyle` -> 'Altered page', nothing written; `set label` and create page -> a core LabelTemplate beside the own `label` (describe prints two labels); check refuses buttonStyle 'fillBlue' (MDL-WIDGET02) and icon 'bookmark' (not a qualified reference); create page and use building block drop the icon
cause: Four resolvers each read the name as the core property before asking the widget: setRawWidgetPropertyMut's caption/label/buttonstyle cases ran before the pluggable fallback; validateStaticWidget ran GetButtonStyle on every widget; the icon-reference walk took every `icon:`; the engine's explicit pass skipped isBuiltinPropName names, Finalize wrote w.GetLabel() as a LabelTemplate on every CustomWidget, and stringifyAny returned "" for the *ast.WidgetIcon the visitor makes of every `icon:`
file: mdl/backend/pagemutator/mutator.go (setRawWidgetPropertyMut, pluggableDeclaresOwnKey); mdl/executor/widget_engine.go (explicit pass, Finalize label, stringifyAny); mdl/executor/validate_widgets.go (validateStaticWidgetOf); mdl/executor/validate_icon_refs.go (iconRefsToResolve, storedWidgetOwnsIcon); sdk/pages/pluggable_own_property.go
insight: A core name on a CustomWidget is only ambiguous when the widget does not store the core property at all — so the question is 'does the definition declare this key, and not as a System property' (a combo box's Label is ValueType System and keeps the core route). Ask it once per layer from one name list (pages.PluggableKeyShadowsCoreName) rather than per symptom: the report named three symptoms, the walk found six sites. PDS is not downloadable, but a hand-made .mpk with the same keys reproduced every symptom against real mx 11.12.1, and the BadgeButton shipped with Atlas (own `label`) showed the double-LabelTemplate on a real package; the building-block icon loss is the same stringifyAny drop because the block is copied through describe -> re-parse.
